CustomField.description: The most of an org limit that AI Assist itself may use for the Chat feature, measured from its own jobs, events and records. When its own usage reaches this share the feature is Paused even if the org has headroom. Between 5 and 100. Blank uses Org Limit Maximum Share Percent; both blank means no share budget.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: AI Assist's own share of a limit, 5 to 100. Blank uses Org Limit Maximum Share Percent.
CustomField.label: Chat App Share Percent
